file_insights.content_summary: Detailed workflow failure investigation for staging data sync

patterns_discovered: Both staging and production environments failed simultaneously
Failure occurs in 'Sync data' step with exit code 1
Short execution time (~6 seconds) suggests early process failure
Sync workflow follows a consistent 4-phase data transformation pipeline
gotchas_discovered: Lack of detailed error logging in GitHub Actions
Limited log access without admin repository rights

approach_outcome.hypothesis: External dependency (Parliament API) likely caused synchronization failure

recommendations: Access full workflow logs to identify exact error message
Check Supabase service status and credential validity
Implement more robust error logging in sync process
Add retry mechanism for external API calls
